description: Installations de valorisation du biogaz en projet en Pays de la Loire is a dataset listed in data.teo-paysdelaloire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by TEO. Ce jeu de données concerne les installations de valorisation du biogaz en projet (en projet ("instruction icpe en cours", "instruction icpe finie", "pas d'instruction icpe" et en travaux) en Pays de la Loire au 31 décembre 2025. Il est issu d'un croisement de données multi-sources réalisé par l'observatoire TEO avec le logiciel R. Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are TEO, Energie-Climat, Installations EnR, Production EnR, Gaz renouvelables. The portal shows 48 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-teo-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
